eps.t: The Witch with One Year to Live
eps.ov: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.

eps.t: The Apprentice Witch and the People of Lapis
eps.ov: Meg's friend Fine requests her help with fixing a watch.
Meg is visited by Inori, the Witch of Wisdom, while Faust is away on business.

eps.t: Blessings With the Opening of the Gate
eps.ov: Meg helps Sophie, the Witch of Blessings and one of the Seven Sages, open the gate at the Otherworld Festival.

eps.t: Flowers Bloom in the Festival Night Sky
eps.ov: While preparing for the parade, Meg and Sophie meet Marie, a woman looking for the man she met a year ago.
Meg brags to Faust about how easy it has become to collect tears and is forbidden from using magic.
Meg attends a special magic ceremony held once every 20 years.

eps.t: The Family Bewitched by a Devil
eps.ov: Meg sees a burn-like scar on a girl's neck that is only visible to her.
The sacred tree of Lapis has become polluted by magic and must be removed to prevent further damage.

eps.t: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part One)
eps.ov: Meg and Inori visit Aquamarine, a resort destination with a cutting-edge medical facility.

eps.t: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part Two)
eps.ov: Meg and Jack experience a breakthrough in their research, and a massive disaster threatens the entire island.
Meg has mysterious nightmares about a lone witch floating above a destroyed city.
